title: 第1章 穿越第2章 金手指与册封
slug: 穿越自带炼妖壶桀桀顷刻炼化
content_zh:
男频三大美德：孟德之志、亡灵骑士、草莽英雄，本书会涉及两到三个，请老爷们带好安全带，发车了。
（世界地图）
今天已经是聂力穿越后的第3天了，用了三天的时间，聂力总算是搞清楚了自己的现状。
自己穿越到了一个叫泰伦大陆的世界，目前是泰伦历1580年夏天。
这是一个类似西方中世纪的世界，不过这个世界有着斗气与魔法，还有神奇的龙与精灵。
自己现在叫做罗恩·西兰花，是一名男爵次子。
西兰花的姓氏来源于家族最初的西兰花小精灵。
有着极高的斗气修炼天赋，外貌英俊，生活多姿多彩。
因没有资格继承爵位。
西兰花男爵托关系把他送到了科隆侯爵的金盏花骑士团，接受更好的骑士培养，以求搏一个出路。
骑士团里大多都是天赋不错但没有继承权的贵族子嗣，以及侯爵从小培养的平民骑士。
18岁的罗恩在骑士团已经修炼4年了，现在是一名低阶骑士扈从。
一个低阶扈从对付七八个全副武装的士兵不在话下。
而罗恩在低阶扈从里也是佼佼者，仅差一步就可以晋升中阶骑士扈从了。
结果遇到了黑铁公国和所在的黄铜公国边境冲突。
罗恩所在的金盏花骑士团也前往作战。
前身前期凭借出色的战力立了不少军功，到了冲突后期，骑士团遭遇了一次伏击，损伤惨重。
罗恩临阵突破中阶骑士扈从，又踩狗屎运救了侯爵的长子，带着他突围出来。
自己却重伤嘎了。聂力就是这时候穿越过来的。
聂力可以说是一个孤儿。从小父母离婚，都各自组建了家庭，没人愿意管他。他只有跟着奶奶生活。

后来奶奶在他上初中的时候去世，聂力就彻底没人管了。
从小到大，受尽了欺负和白眼，不过这些没有压倒他，却是彻底激发了他的野性。
学习不好，就辍学出去混，搬过砖，打过工。当过中介，包过工程，送过礼，也被兄弟背刺破过产。
终于在快到三十而立之年时混起来了。
可以算得上是小有成就，勉强算是财富自由。
就在刚和一个瑜伽裤聊完人生，回去的路上，一辆大运直奔他而来。
一下就把他送到了异世界。
聂力想，是不是自己干的缺德事太多了才遭报应。
自己好不容易摸爬滚打，在先富的阻击下实现后富。
刚过上和美女贴贴，没羞没臊的腐败生活没多久。
怎么就一下给自己送异世界来了？
不过睁眼成了贵族，这起点可比上辈子强多了。
这要是穿越成了农奴，奴隶。
聂力搞不好就要找棵歪脖子树，重开了。
content_en:
The three major virtues of male porn: Meng De's ambition, the undead knight, and the reckless hero. This book will cover two or three of them. Please put on your seat belts and get going.
(world map)
Today is already the third day after Nie Li traveled through time. After three days, Nie Li finally figured out his current situation.
He traveled to a world called the Terran Continent. It is currently the summer of 1580 in the Tyran calendar.
This is a world similar to the Western Middle Ages, but this world has fighting spirit and magic, as well as magical dragons and elves.
He is now called Ron Broccoli, the second son of a baron.
Broccoli's surname comes from the family's original broccoli elf.
He has extremely high talent in fighting spirit cultivation, handsome appearance, and colorful life.
Because he is not qualified to inherit the title.
Baron Broccoli sent him to the Marigold Knights of the Marquis of Cologne through his connections to receive better knight training in order to find a way out.
Most of the knights are descendants of nobles with good talents but no inheritance rights, as well as civilian knights trained by the Marquis since childhood.
The 18-year-old Ron has been practicing in the Knights for 4 years and is now a low-level knight attendant.
It's no problem for a low-level retinue to deal with seven or eight fully armed soldiers.
And Ron is also a leader among low-level retinues, and is only one step away from being promoted to mid-level knight retinue.
As a result, they encountered a border conflict between the Black Iron Principality and the Brass Principality where it was located.
Ron's Marigold Knights also went to fight.
In the early stages of the conflict, the predecessor achieved many military exploits with its outstanding combat prowess. However, in the later stages of the conflict, the Knights suffered an ambush and suffered heavy damage.
Ron broke through the middle-level knight's retinue before the battle, used some bad luck to save the Marquis' eldest son, and led him out of the encirclement.
But he was seriously injured. It was at this time that Nie Li traveled through time.
Nie Li can be said to be an orphan. His parents divorced when he was young, and they all started their own families, and no one wanted to care about him. He only lives with his grandma.
Later, his grandmother passed away when he was in junior high school, and Nie Li was completely left alone.
Growing up, he was bullied and looked down upon. However, these did not overwhelm him, but completely inspired his wild nature.
If he didn't study well, he dropped out of school and went out to work, moving bricks and working. I worked as an intermediary, contracted projects, gave gifts, and was stabbed in the back by my brother and gave birth.
Finally, when he was approaching his thirties, he finally got involved.
It can be regarded as a small achievement, and it can barely be regarded as financial freedom.
Just after chatting about life with a guy in yoga pants, on his way back, a truck headed straight for him.
He was instantly transported to another world.
Nie Li wondered if he was getting retribution for doing too many immoral things.
After a lot of hard work, I finally became rich later under the obstruction of the first rich.
It hasn't been long since I started living a corrupt life of hanging out with beautiful women without any shame.
Why did you send yourself to another world all at once?
But when you open your eyes and become a noble, your starting point is much better than in your previous life.
What if you traveled through time and became a serf, a slave.
Nie Li might have to find a crooked neck tree and reopen it.
